annotations.title: Loan and mortgage calculator: monthly payment, total interest and schedule

description: Monthly payment of an amortised loan or mortgage from the amount, the annual interest rate and the term, plus the total paid, the total interest and the first months of the repayment schedule (principal, interest and balance). Fixed rate, monthly payments. Use to compare loan offers or plan a mortgage. Example: principal=300000, rate=4.5. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
